::: {#exm-IQR}
#### Quartiles and IQR of cholesterol in the WCGS

```{r}
quantile(wcgs$chol, probs = c(0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)
IQR(wcgs$chol, na.rm = TRUE)
```

The middle half of the cholesterol values span
`r IQR(wcgs$chol, na.rm = TRUE)` mg/dL.
Like the median, the IQR does not depend on the most extreme values,
so it is less sensitive to outliers than the standard deviation.
:::
